summary: Phase 3 tiered loyalty: 11/11 backend tests PASS, all critical frontend UI flows verified. Backend: GET /api/me/tier returns correct shape and Silver/Gold/Platinum thresholds (demo user is Gold with lifetime=1500, balance=500, next_at=5000, progress≈0.3, perks list, color=#D4AF37). POST /api/payments/verify earn math validated for all three tiers: Silver=round(amount*0.05) no boost; Gold (lifetime≥1000)=round(amount*0.05*1.05) with boost_pct=5; Platinum (lifetime≥5000)=round(amount*0.05*1.10) with boost_pct=10. lifetime_points increments by earned amount (verified pre/post). tier_up returns true exactly once when crossing 1000 threshold (Silver→Gold via 20k booking earns 1000), and false on subsequent same-tier bookings. /payments/verify idempotency confirmed — second call returns {already_paid:true} with same earned/redeemed values and NO additional lifetime_points increment. /me/apply-referral bumps lifetime_points by +200 for BOTH referrer and referee (verified delta). /me/points regression: works (200) and earn-type history entries store boost_pct + tier fields. Frontend (mobile 390x844): Profile Tier pill shows '🏆 Gold Member +5% bonus' in gold color (#D4AF37) ✓. Tier pill tap navigates to /points ✓. Points screen tier card shows: gold trophy icon circle, 'Gold' name in gold, +5% boost badge, '3500 pts to Platinum' progress text, progress bar, 'Lifetime earned: 1500', and perks list ('5% bonus cashback', 'Early access to combos') ✓. Balance card shows 500 pts. Points history items from new bookings would show small '+5% Gold' tag inline (verified via code at points.tsx:96-98 — checks item.boost_pct). Checkout tier-up banner verified at code level (checkout/[bookingId].tsx:69-74 — gold #FFD700 banner with trophy icon shows when verify.tier_up=true) and backend produces tier_up=true at threshold crossings.

issues: RN-Web warnings persist (shadow* deprecated → use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated → use style.pointerEvents) — cosmetic, web-only

action_items: (Optional) Align Expo package versions via `yarn expo install --check` to silence SDK drift warnings on every boot.

(Optional) server.py is now 928 lines (was 886 in iteration 2) — well over 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, vendors, bookings, payments, referrals/tier, chat, ai, vendor_self, ws).
critical_code_review_comments: compute_tier() correctly returns Silver/Gold/Platinum based on lifetime thresholds (0, 1000, 5000). Stateless, pure function — clean.

Earn calc applies boost based on PRE-earn lifetime (lifetime_before via DB read before $inc), which is the correct semantic — you earn this booking's boost at your current tier, not the post-credit tier.
lifetime_points $inc happens atomically alongside points $inc — good.
tier_up check compares new_tier.name vs old tier.name from lifetime_before/new_lifetime — correctly fires once per crossing.
Idempotency guard at /payments/verify (line 547-551) returns early on already-paid bookings without re-awarding — fixes the iteration 2 minor finding.
/me/apply-referral now $inc's lifetime_points alongside points for BOTH users — referrals do progress tier as intended.
/me/tier projects only {lifetime_points, points} — no ObjectId leak, no password_hash leak.
point_history entries now include tier + boost_pct for earn rows — enables UI badge.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase 3 critical flows verified — tier pill on profile (color+icon+boost%), tier pill tap → /points navigation, tier card on points (icon circle, name in tier color, boost badge, progress bar with remaining pts, lifetime earned, perks list)
